line: Tracks website visits, individual sessions, replay and heatmaps.

free.text: Free Basic: 5,000 sessions/month; older 250K-view cap conflicts

pv.math: Assumes 1 pageview per session. 10,000 sessions fit the Premium 20K plan. The free plan includes 5,000 sessions a month. An older claim of 250K views conflicts with this.
Assumes 1 pageview per session. 100,000 sessions fit the Premium 100K plan. The free plan includes 5,000 sessions a month. An older claim of 250K views conflicts with this.
Assumes 1 pageview per session. 1,000,000 sessions fit the Premium 1M plan. The free plan includes 5,000 sessions a month. An older claim of 250K views conflicts with this.
